panels.description: Alex presses his scarred palm to a wet riveted pipe while Bi11bot compares an adjacent dry line. Keep the mechanical vibration in lower-left space for the SFX; leave upper-right completely clear for Alex’s first balloon and lower-right for Bi11bot’s question, with Alex’s final reply in lower-left.

Old gauges and manual wheels fill the regulator gallery. A clean cable and control line graft into a compact white-and-amber node, with matching cable architecture visibly continuing along the gallery toward the basin-wide infrastructure spine. Leave the upper band clear for the dialogue sequence.

Alex follows the clean line into the newer housing bolted over an old valve plate while Bi11bot leans close. Leave upper-left for PIP, upper-right for Bi11bot, middle-right for Alex’s first answer, and bottom-right for Bi11bot’s question.
Alex scrapes mineral crust away, revealing repeating loops around the node. His watch hangs beside the etched pattern. Keep the pattern and watch unobstructed; reserve upper-left for SFX only.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Someone fed a new control into an old regulator.
